blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Immersive 3D content allows text and graphical elements, such as subtitles, annotations, and icons, to be placed inside a scene rather than displayed as flat overlays. Placed this way, they respect occlusion and perspective and take on user-assigned materials and lighting while preserving their original shapes. In Gaussian scenes, however, each new glyph or icon requires its own iterative optimization, which limits scalable content creation. We present FFGaussType, which converts extruded glyph and SVG outlines into Gaussian assets in a single forward pass. A point encoder maps anchors sampled on the known surface to a single feature plane, from which a decoder shared by all assets predicts neural Gaussians carrying surface normals. This separates geometric conversion from material and lighting choices, and the feature plane supports image and video coding for compact delivery. We construct a paired dataset of 27,221 glyph and SVG icon assets with anchors and calibrated normal and silhouette renderings, holding out font families for evaluation. Conversion from prepared anchors takes 9.1 ms per asset, at a fraction of the compute and memory of prior baselines. On unseen font families and test icons, FFGaussType achieves $1.62^\circ$ normal error and $0.985$ silhouette IoU, the best among the compared feed-forward converters, matching the fidelity that per-asset fitting needs thousands of steps to reach. The code and dataset will be released after publication.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Immersive 3D content lets text and graphical elements, such as subtitles, annotations, and icons, become part of the scene instead of flat overlays on top of it.
Once inserted, they must remain legible as the camera moves and take on the chosen appearance.
Representing them as Gaussian-based assets allows rendering alongside Gaussian-based static scenes [ 19 ] and dynamic volumetric videos [ 38 ] , with correct depth occlusion against scene content.
Their shape is already specified by an outline , the closed 2D contours of a font glyph or SVG graphic, and its 3D extrusion.
Our task is to convert this known geometry into neural Gaussians that preserve its silhouette and surface normals, leaving material and lighting under the user’s control ( Fig. 1 ).
We call this task conversion because the source geometry is supplied.
blocks.zh:
immersive 3D内容让文字和图形元素,如字幕,说明,以及图标,成为场景的一部分,而不是上面的平面覆盖.
一旦被插入,它们必须随着镜头的移动而保持清晰,并承担选定的外观.
将它们作为高斯基于资产来表示,可以与高斯基于静态场景[19]和动态卷片[38]一起渲染,对场景内容进行正确的深度隔离.
其形状已由一个大纲、一个字体格莱弗或SVG图形的闭合2D轮廓及其3D外观来指定。
我们的任务是将这种已知的几何学转换成神经高斯学,以保持其硅和表面的正常性,使材料和照明置于用户的控制之下(图1)。
我们称这个任务转换是因为源几何是供应的.

blocks.en:
The known geometry provides supervision, but the Gaussians still need positions, extents, orientations, and opacities whose blend reproduces the surface.
This is hardest at the rim , where the flat front and back faces, or caps , meet the narrow side walls and the surface normal changes abruptly.
Per-scene optimization [ 19 ] can fit each asset, but it repeats thousands of iterations for every new glyph or icon.
We instead train one converter on many fonts and icon collections and apply it to a new asset in a single forward pass.
Existing feed-forward Gaussian models infer assets from images [ 34 , 35 , 45 , 49 ] , and TexGaussian [ 41 ] predicts appearance on a given surface. Our converter instead takes the known geometry as input and is trained to reproduce its rendered normals and silhouettes.

已知的几何提供了监督,但高斯人仍然需要位置,范围,方向和不透明,其混合体复制表面.
平坦的前脸和后脸, 或盖子, 与狭窄的侧壁相遇,
per-scene explain [19] 可以适应每个资产,但它重复了每个新格莱弗或图标的数千次迭代.
相反,我们在许多字体和图标集上培训一个转换器,并将其应用到一个单一前传的新资产中。
现有的feed-forward Gaussian模型从图像推断资产[34,35,45,49],TexGausian[41]预测在特定表面出现. 我们的转换器则把已知的几何学作为输入,并接受训练,以复制其成形的常态和硅胶。

blocks.en:
Our FFGaussType builds on anchor-based decoding [ 28 ] and the feature planes of TV-GS [ 18 ] .
A point encoder maps precomputed surface anchors to a single 2D feature plane defined over the outline, and a decoder shared by all assets queries it to produce neural Gaussians carrying normals, using the anchor depth to separate the front and back caps.
Both networks are trained jointly, and the decoder produces Gaussian parameters for each camera.
Each asset stores only its anchors and feature planes, whose 2D planar structure makes the representation compatible with standard image and video codecs for efficient compression and deployment. Materials and lighting can then be independently assigned or modified at the receiving end, enabling flexible appearance control.
blocks.zh:
我们的FFGaussType基于主播解码[28]和TV-GS[18]的特写飞机.
一个点编码器将预算的表面锚地映射到一个在大纲上定义的单一2D特性平面,和一个所有资产共享的解码器查询它来产生携带正常的神经高斯人,利用锚地深度来分离前盖和后盖.
两个网络都是联合训练的,解码器为每个相机产生高斯参数.
每个资产只储存其锚和特征飞机,其2D平面结构使该代表与标准图像和视频编码兼容,以高效压缩和部署. 然后材料和照明可以在接收端独立指定或修改,从而能够进行灵活的外观控制。

blocks.en:
We construct a paired dataset of 27,221 assets spanning 256 font families and SVG icon collections.
Selected letters, digits, and punctuation, together with icon outlines, are paired with normalized extrusions, anchors, and calibrated normal and silhouette images from 40 views.
Family-disjoint splits support learning and evaluating conversion to unseen typefaces, while the paired geometry and views support matched per-asset fitting comparisons.
blocks.zh:
我们构建了一个由27 221个资产组成的组合数据集,涵盖256个字体家庭和SVG图标集。
选定的字母,数字,和标点图,以及图标大纲,都与40个视图的规范的外观,锚,以及校准的正常和斜线图像对齐.
家庭分裂支持学习和评价转换为隐形类型,而对齐的几何学和视图支持则匹配每个资产匹配的比较。

blocks.en:
On the full test split, FFGaussType achieves 1.62 ∘ 1.62^{\circ} normal error and 0.985 0.985 silhouette IoU, the best values among the compared feed-forward converters, with a prepared-anchor conversion time of 9.1 ms per asset.
It also has lower forward computation and peak memory than the compared feed-forward methods.
On a shared 64-asset subset, its one-pass normal error is lower than 3DGS and a single-plane variant of TV-GS fitted per asset even after 32k optimization steps, while Scaffold-GS surpasses it only after 16k steps at roughly triple the uncompressed per-asset storage.
On the same subset, HEVC coding at QP 22 stores an asset in 23.9 kB on average, raising normal error by 0.05 ∘ 0.05^{\circ} .
Our main contributions are: • A feed-forward converter from glyph and SVG geometry to Gaussian assets that preserve the source silhouette and surface normals, enabling physically based shading under user-assigned homogeneous materials and lighting. • A paired dataset spanning font families and SVG outlines, with anchors and calibrated multi-view supervision for conversion and family-level generalization studies. • Experiments demonstrating conversion fidelity and low forward cost against feed-forward and per-asset fitting baselines, with controlled studies of plane prediction, feature layout, refinement, and coded delivery.

blocks.en:
Gaussian reconstruction and conversion. Gaussian representations can be obtained by optimizing an individual asset or by predicting it with a network shared across assets.
3DGS [ 19 ] fits free Gaussians to posed images with pruning and adaptive densification, while Scaffold-GS [ 28 ] decodes Gaussian attributes from spatial anchors and their features.
For known geometry, fitting becomes conversion from a supplied surface.
PBR-TV-GS [ 23 ] optimizes tri-planes and decoder networks using normals and material values obtained directly from mesh intersections and UV textures.
Mesh2Splat [ 31 ] and GaMeS [ 36 ] attach Gaussians to mesh triangles and 2DGS [ 14 ] fits surface-aligned disks, each yielding per-asset primitives rather than a fixed-size, codec-ready feature plane.
Feed-forward methods instead predict Gaussians from one or a few views. Splatter Image [ 34 ] , GS-LRM [ 45 ] and LGM [ 35 ] use per-pixel outputs, whereas TriplaneGaussian [ 49 ] predicts through a point cloud and tri-plane.
These methods infer the surface from its images.
Geometry-conditioned approaches receive the surface directly. TexGaussian [ 41 ] predicts material Gaussians on a mesh-derived octree in one pass, and GaussianGrow [ 47 ] grows Gaussians from a point cloud through per-asset optimization under a text-guided diffusion prior.
Like these approaches, we condition on supplied geometry, but perform the conversion in a single feed-forward pass, with the rendered normal field and silhouette as the targets to preserve.
Whereas TexGaussian predicts appearance on a surface that remains explicit at render time, our Gaussians must themselves reproduce that surface.
blocks.zh:
高斯重建与改造. 高斯表示可以通过优化个人资产或通过跨资产共享的网络预测获得.
3DGS [19]适合自由的高斯人以普鲁士化和适应性的密度来呈现图像,而Scaffold-GS [28]从空间锚及其特征解码高斯人的属性.
就已知的几何学而言,配位从供应的表面转换。
PBR-TV-GS [23] 利用直接从网状交叉点和紫外线纹理中获得的常态和物质值,优化三机和解码器网络.

饲料向导方法代替预测 高斯人从一个或几个观点。 溅射图像[34],GS-LRM[45]和LGM[35]使用每像素输出,而TriplaneGausian[49]则通过点云和三平面预测.
这些方法从它的图像中推断出表面.

和这些方法一样,我们以所提供的几何学为条件,但是在一条向前进的通道中进行转换,将变形的正常场和硅面作为目标来保存.

blocks.en:
Surface appearance and relighting. Normals and reflectance allow Gaussian geometry to support relighting instead of storing only rendered color.
GaussianShader [ 17 ] , R3DGS [ 10 ] and GS-IR [ 27 ] estimate surface appearance and lighting from multi-view images using Gaussian representations augmented with normals and reflectance.
RelitLRM [ 46 ] combines feed-forward geometry prediction from sparse views with diffusion-based generation of relit Gaussian appearance.
In our setting, the known geometry supplies normal supervision, while the material and lights are assigned by the user.
blocks.zh:
表面外观与重燃. 常态和反射使得高斯几何能够支持重光而不是只存储制成的颜色.
GaussianShader [17], R3DGS [10] 和 GS-IR [27] 利用高斯表示法加固了常态和反射的多视图图像,估计表面外观和照明.
RelitLRM [46] 结合了从稀疏的视角出发的向导几何预测和基于扩散的生成的Relit Gaussian外观.
在我们的环境下,已知的几何提供正常的监管,而材料和灯光则由用户指定.

blocks.en:
Structured and compact representations. A regular image layout of features makes Gaussian data accessible to image networks and standard codecs.
Splatter Image [ 34 ] stores a Gaussian per pixel, UVGS [ 29 ] maps a fitted object to a spherical UV image for generative modeling, and SIGMAN [ 43 ] learns a UV-structured latent for human avatars.
Feature planes also build on factorizations used in neural rendering [ 4 , 5 , 8 ] .
CodecGS [ 24 ] replaces per-Gaussian attributes with tri-plane features for video coding, and TV-GS [ 18 ] codes anchor features as video frames alongside an octree of anchor positions.
Other approaches address different parts of delivery. FCGS [ 6 ] learns to compress fitted Gaussian sets, while AtlasLC [ 20 ] compresses object-centric Gaussian assets into codec-ready atlases, treating the reusable asset as the delivery unit.
Our representation adopts TV-GS’s anchor and feature-plane layout and learns the mapping from an asset’s sampled geometry to its feature plane, queried by a decoder shared by all assets.
blocks.zh:
结构化和紧凑的表述。 特征的常规图像布局使得高斯数据可以被图像网络和标准解码器访问.
Splatter Image [34] 存储每个像素的高斯琴,UVGS [29] 映射一个配有球形紫外线图像的物体,用于基因造型,SIGMAN [43] 学习人体造型的紫外线结构潜伏.
地物平面还建立在神经渲染[4,5,8]中使用的因子化.
CodecGS [24] 将每架Gausian的属性替换为用于视频编码的三平板特性,以及TV-GS [18] 代码主播特性作为视频帧,与一个主播位置的八角形.
其他办法涉及交付的不同部分。 FCGS [6] 学会压缩安装高斯组,而AtlasLC [20] 则将以对象为中心的高斯组资产压缩成可编码的准备地图集,将可重复使用的资产作为交付单元处理.
我们的代表采用TV-GS的主播和专题飞机布局,并学习从资产取样几何到其专题平面的绘图,由所有资产共用的解码器询问。

blocks.en:
Vector graphics, 3D text and training data. Generative work on typography and vector graphics addresses the creation and stylization of glyphs and vector art.
Word-As-Image [ 16 ] deforms outlines to convey a word’s meaning, VecGlypher [ 15 ] generates glyph outlines with a language model, and DeepSVG [ 3 ] , StarVector [ 30 ] and OmniSVG [ 42 ] generate SVG graphics.
DreamFont3D [ 26 ] and SplatFont3D [ 9 ] optimize stylized 3D fonts per asset from text prompts.
Our method instead starts from a chosen outline and preserves its extruded geometry.
Existing datasets provide several of the ingredients needed to supervise this task.
DeepCAD [ 39 ] pairs vector profiles with extrusions, and MV2Cyl [ 12 ] renders them from multiple views.
ABC [ 22 ] provides exact normals of CAD models, OmniObject3D [ 40 ] provides multi-view normals of scanned objects, and Syn3DTxt [ 13 ] supplies rendered 3D text for scene-text generation and editing.
However, to our knowledge, no existing dataset jointly provides glyph and SVG outlines, sampled anchors, and calibrated normal/silhouette renderings of their extrusions.
We curate this paired dataset for our conversion task, with a font-family split to evaluate conversion to unseen typefaces.
blocks.zh:
矢量图形,3D文本和培训数据. 关于打字和矢量图形的遗传性工作涉及甘油和矢量艺术的创造和结构化.
Word-As-Image [16] 变形的轮廓来表达一个词的含义,VecGlypher [15] 生成带有语言模型的glyph轮廓,DeepSVG [3],StarVector [30]和OmniSVG [42] 生成SVG图形.
DreamFont3D [26] 和 SplatFont3D [9] 从文本提示每个资产中优化了标定的3D字体.
相反,我们的方法是从一个选定的轮廓开始的,并保留其外形几何。
现有数据集提供了监督这项任务所需的若干要素。
DeepCAD [39] 配对的矢量剖面图,带有挤压,MV2Cyl [12] 使其从多个角度产生.
ABC [22] 提供了CAD模型的准确正常,Omni Object3D [40] 提供了扫描对象的多视图正常,Syn3DTxt [13] 供给为场景文本生成和编辑提供了3D文本.
然而,据我们所知,没有现有的数据集共同提供甘油和SVG的轮廓,采样锚,以及校准其外延的正常/光线渲染。
我们为转换任务整理了这个对齐的数据集, 并用一个字体- 家族的分割来评价转换到看不见的打印面。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem and representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题和代表性

blocks.en:
We convert the extruded outline of a glyph or SVG graphic, i.e . , its closed 2D contours, into a Gaussian asset whose materials and lighting are assigned afterwards ( Fig. 2 ).
The input is a set of normalized anchors 𝒜 = { 𝐚 i } i = 1 M \mathcal{A}=\{\mathbf{a}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{M} , with 𝐚 i = ( x i , y i , z i ) \mathbf{a}_{i}=(x_{i},y_{i},z_{i}) , sampled from the known surface during preprocessing.
In FFGaussType, an asset is represented by its anchors and a feature plane from which a decoder predicts Gaussians.
An encoder E θ E_{\theta} maps the anchor positions to a single 2D feature plane 𝐏 ∈ ℝ C × G × G \mathbf{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times G\times G} with C = 48 C=48 channels. G = 64 G=64 is the side dimension of the feature plane.
A decoder D ϕ D_{\phi} reads 𝐏 \mathbf{P} at each anchor and predicts K = 6 K=6 candidate Gaussians carrying surface normals.
On our dataset, the encoder and decoder are trained end-to-end from normals and silhouette of the source geometry.

blocks.en: 3.2 Geometry preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.2 几何预处理

blocks.en:
Normal error concentrates at the rim, where the caps meet the side walls and the surface normal changes abruptly, yet this narrow region makes up little of the surface area.
Preprocessing therefore concentrates anchors there.
We first normalize and rasterize the outline within [ − 1 , 1 ] 2 [-1,1]^{2} , extract simplified polygonal contours, and extrude the enclosed region to z = ± 0.125 z=\pm 0.125 .
We then place 35% of anchors along rim edges, favoring high-curvature contour regions, and distribute the rest by farthest-point sampling over the surface.
The anchor count M M grows with contour length at fixed extrusion depth, bounded by 1000 ≤ M ≤ 4096 1000\leq M\leq 4096 , with sampling constants fixed across the dataset.
Only normalized anchor coordinates enter the network as input.
blocks.zh:
正常的误差集中在边缘,其中的盖子与侧壁相遇,表面的正常变化突然,然而这个狭窄的区域却很少构成表面面积.
因此,预处理集中在那里。
我们首先在[− 1, 1] 2 [-1, 1] ^{2] 内使轮廓正常化和光圈化,提取简化多边形轮廓,并将封闭区域挤到 z = ± 0.125 z =\pm 0.125 。
然后沿边缘放置35%的锚, 倾向于高曲率的轮廓区域, 其余的分布在最远的取样点上。
锚数M M在固定的挤压深度以轮廓长度生长,以1000 ≤ M ≤ 4096 1000\leq M\leq 4096为界,取样常数固定在数据集之间.
只有正常的锚坐标作为输入进入网络.

blocks.en: 3.3 Encoding geometry in a feature plane

blocks.en:
Anchor counts range from 1000 to 4096 across assets, whereas compact delivery with standard codecs needs a latent of fixed size and layout.
We therefore predict a single image-shaped feature plane from the anchors, replacing the per-asset plane fitting of TV-GS [ 18 ] with one encoder pass.

因此,我们预测一个单一的图像形状的特性平面从锚部,用一个编码器通过取代TV-GS[18]的每资产平面配置.

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
The decoder must recover a closed 3D surface from features stored on a 2D plane.
Points on the front and back caps with the same ( x , y ) (x,y) receive the same plane feature, although their normals point in opposite directions.
Each decoder head therefore also receives the original anchor coordinate, including raw depth z z , to separate them.
We adapt TV-GS’s five-head, two-layer MLP decoder [ 18 ] to predict the K K Gaussians per anchor, with normals replacing color channels (Supp. Tab. C1 ).

blocks.en:
For plane refinement, we initialize 𝐏 \mathbf{P} from E θ ​ ( 𝒜 ) E_{\theta}(\mathcal{A}) , freeze the decoder, and minimize Eq. 3 over the plane alone using Adam [ 21 ] and reference images of the known geometry.
We store the optimized plane with unchanged dimensions and 16-bit payload, using the same quantization and codec as for predictions.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en:
Dataset. Our dataset contains 27,221 glyph and SVG icon assets, each pairing an outline with its normalized extrusion, sampled anchors, and world-space normal and silhouette images rendered by Blender [ 2 ] from 40 cameras at 512 2 512^{2} resolution.
We split glyphs by font family, with 206 families for training and 25 each for validation and testing. All characters occur in every split.
Icons are split by source collection.
The splits contain 21,904 training, 2,660 validation, and 2,657 test assets. Construction details and statistics are in Supp. Sec. A .

blocks.en:
Evaluation. Of the 40 cameras, 32 provide views for training, fitting, and refinement. The remaining eight are held out for scoring every method.
We report normal error , the mean angular difference between rendered and reference world-space normals over foreground pixels, and silhouette IoU , thresholding rendered alpha at 0.5 0.5 .
The edge band contains foreground pixels within one pixel of a reference-normal crease of at least 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} .
Its share of foreground pixels over all 40 reference views defines edge fraction , a model-free measure of geometric difficulty used to select and stratify assets.
All outputs use the same rasterizer [ 44 ] at 512 2 512^{2} . Scores are averaged over the eight views per asset, then over assets.
Full-test results average three training seeds for every converter, and the 64-asset fitting comparison uses one.
Hyperparameters are selected on the validation assets. Forward cost covers prepared inputs to Gaussian parameters at batch size 1 on an NVIDIA RTX A6000.

Refining our predicted plane for 10 s lowers normal error to 1.31 ∘ 1.31^{\circ} , below every fitting result, and Sec. 4.5 examines the regional gains and silhouette trade-off.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation studies

blocks.en: We study the prediction and representation choices that let a single feature plane describe the extruded geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了让单一的特征平面描述挤压几何的预测和表达选择.

blocks.en:
Plane prediction and decoder sharing. On 32 training assets, we compare encoder-predicted planes with a shared decoder (A), directly fitted planes with a shared decoder (B), and directly fitted planes with separate decoders (C).
Each setting uses three seeds and 16k training cycles with matched view exposure (Supp. Sec. C.3 ), scored on the same eight held-out views per asset. Figure 5 shows that A reaches 1.44 ∘ 1.44^{\circ} normal error, compared with 2.11 ∘ 2.11^{\circ} for B and 2.10 ∘ 2.10^{\circ} for C, and improves on B for every asset.
Fitted planes reach their lowest held-out error after 5k–6k cycles and then degrade, whereas the encoder continues to improve.
Prediction ties all planes to a common mapping from anchor geometry instead of letting each specialize to its fitting views, consistent with a regularizing effect, and the nearly identical errors of B and C show that decoder sharing alone does not explain the gain.

blocks.en: 4.6 Asset delivery and reuse
blocks.zh: 4.6 国家 资产交付和再利用

blocks.en:
We measure how coding affects predicted planes on the 64-asset fitting subset.
The default model uses no compression objective. Its planes are quantized and coded with HEVC [ 33 ] after training. Figure 6 compares normal error and silhouette IoU against the combined size of coded anchors and planes.
Lossless still-image codecs preserve the ten-bit plane codes exactly, and JPEG XL [ 1 ] stores an asset in 72.4 kB.
With HEVC, fidelity changes little down to about 24 kB per asset. At QP 22, an asset occupies 23.9 kB on average, with a 0.05 ∘ 0.05^{\circ} increase in normal error over the uncoded result.
Stronger compression increasingly reduces fidelity.
A further 10 s of plane refinement improves normal fidelity, storing the optimized plane while keeping the shared networks fixed.
Refined planes cost more plane bytes at equal QP, but retain lower normal error at equal total asset size down to 16.6 kB.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented FFGaussType, which converts known glyph and SVG geometry into reusable Gaussian assets instead of fitting each new asset separately.
Trained on paired outlines, sampled anchors, and multi-view renderings, the converter maps anchor positions to a feature plane that a decoder shared by all assets turns into neural Gaussians with surface normals.
It reaches 1.62 ∘ 1.62^{\circ} normal error on the full test split in 9.1 ms from prepared anchors, the best fidelity among the compared feed-forward converters, and 10 s of plane refinement surpasses the best per-asset fitting result in normal accuracy.
The plane remains an image-shaped latent that can be refined or coded after prediction, and normal-based rendering leaves materials and lighting configurations to the user.
Our study focuses on extruded glyph and SVG assets with a homogeneous material per asset, and anchor sampling remains a separate preprocessing step performed once per outline.
The adopted shading does not model self-shadowing or light transport between an asset and its surrounding scene.
Supporting spatially varying materials, such as texture mapping, is left to future work.

它在完全测试时的正常误差达到1.62 ∘ 1.62 ^{\circ}从准备的锚上分出9.1 ms,在比较的饲料向前进的转换器中最忠实,10 s的平面精度超过每个资产的最佳配位结果,达到正常的精度.
平面仍是一种图像形状的潜质,在预测后可以精炼或编码,基于正常的渲染会给用户留下材料和照明配置.

blocks.en: Appendix G Shading and appearance control
blocks.zh: 附录G 遮盖和外观控制

blocks.en:
Appearance assignment uses the deferred metallic-roughness shader adopted from PBR-TV-GS [ 23 ] .
After Gaussian rasterization, each foreground pixel is shaded using its normalized world-space normal, viewing direction, and the asset’s homogeneous albedo, roughness, and metallicity.
The Cook–Torrance model combines a diffuse lobe with GGX specular reflection, Schlick Fresnel, and height-correlated Smith visibility.
Directional lights supply a direction and radiance, while point-light directions are evaluated per pixel.
Spatially constant ambient illumination and material emission can also contribute.
Shading is independent of network training, so materials and lighting can be changed without converting the geometry again.
The resulting nonnegative radiance is transformed to sRGB and composited with the background using the rendered alpha.
blocks.zh:
外观分配使用从PBR-TV-GS[23]中采用的延时金属槽遮蔽器。
高斯光栅化后,每个前方像素都使用其常态世界-空间常态,视线方向,以及资产均匀的反照率,粗糙度和金属度进行遮蔽.
Cook–Torrance模型结合了扩散叶片与GGX光谱反射,Schlick Fresnel,以及高度相关史密斯的能见度.
方向灯提供方向和光线,而点灯方向则每像素评价.
空间常态环境照明和物质排放也可起到促进作用。
遮蔽是独立于网络训练的,因此材料和照明可以改变而不再次转换几何.
由此产生的非负射光被转换为sRGB,并使用渲染的α与背景复合.

blocks.en:
Environment illumination uses either irradiance represented by nine spherical-harmonic coefficients per color channel or a prefiltered equirectangular stack.
For the stack, diffuse illumination samples the blurriest level along the normal and is weighted by the nonmetallic albedo and one minus the Fresnel term.
Glossy illumination samples along the reflected view direction at a level selected by roughness and is weighted by Fresnel.
This approximation omits the second factor of the split-sum approximation and evaluates Fresnel with the normal–view cosine.
blocks.zh:
环境照明使用以每个色通道9个球形-谐振系数为代表的辐照,或者使用预过滤的正方形堆栈.
就堆栈而言,散射照明物对沿常态最模糊的水平进行取样,并按非金属反照率加权,再减去弗雷斯内尔术语。
光滑照明样品沿着反射的视野方向在粗糙度所选择的水平上,由弗雷斯内尔加权.
此近似省略了分和近似的第二个因子,并用正常的–view cosine来评价Fresnel.

blocks.en:
The shader evaluates pixels independently, without visibility queries between the asset, lights, and surrounding scene.
Smith visibility represents microfacet masking, not scene occlusion.
Consequently, this appearance control does not model self-shadowing, cast or received shadows, interreflection, or asset–scene light transport.
Materials are homogeneous within each asset.

blocks.en:
Two videos, available on the project page, animate the scene of Fig. 1 for 10 s at 30 frames per second and 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 resolution, keeping its asset placements, materials, and lights, and starting from its first view.
In coffee-fixed.mp4 the camera stays at this view, and in coffee-wide-left.mp4 it moves to a viewpoint on the left of the scene and back.
The letters hop in turn, the heart pulses, F 1 \mathrm{F}_{1} and F 2 \mathrm{F}_{2} spin in opposite directions, and the star slides behind the glass and back.
The animation changes only instance transforms and light positions, so the converted assets are not predicted again.
The background plays the first 64 frames of the Coffee Martini sequence [ 25 ] , reconstructed with TV-GS [ 18 ] , forward and then backward.
